moods.name: happy
moods.description: Upbeat, joyful music with bright melodies, major keys, and energetic rhythms. Happy music often features high valence, moderate to high energy, and danceable grooves. It elevates mood and is suitable for workouts, parties, and morning routines.

moods.name: chill
moods.description: Relaxed, easygoing music with laid-back grooves, soft textures, and low intensity. Chill music prioritizes atmosphere over energy. It creates a calming environment suitable for unwinding after work or casual socializing.

moods.name: intense
moods.description: High-energy, aggressive, or powerfully emotional music designed to pump up adrenaline. Intense music features heavy instrumentation, fast tempos, driving rhythms, and strong emotional delivery. Ideal for motivation and cathartic release.

moods.name: relaxed
moods.description: Soft, soothing music with gentle dynamics and peaceful atmospheres. Relaxed music often features acoustic instruments, slow tempos, and minimal arrangements. It is designed to reduce stress and promote tranquility.

moods.name: moody
moods.description: Atmospheric, introspective music with emotional complexity and darker tones. Moody music balances beauty with melancholy, often featuring minor keys, reverb, and cinematic textures. It resonates with introspective and creative states.

moods.name: focused
moods.description: Minimal-distraction music designed to enhance concentration and productivity. Focused music typically has steady, unobtrusive patterns, no lyrics, and consistent energy without dramatic shifts.

moods.name: soulful
moods.description: Emotionally rich music with expressive vocals, warm instrumentation, and themes of love, longing, and human experience. Soulful music emphasizes feeling and authenticity over technical flashiness.

moods.name: confident
moods.description: Bold, swagger-filled music with strong beats, assertive delivery, and empowering themes. Confident music boosts self-assurance and is designed to make the listener feel unstoppable.

moods.name: melancholy
moods.description: Sad, wistful music that explores themes of loss, longing, and bittersweet beauty. Melancholy music can be cathartic and comforting, providing emotional release and validation.

moods.name: nostalgic
moods.description: Music that evokes memories, past experiences, and sentimental longing. Nostalgic music often features familiar sounds, vintage production, or personal associations that transport listeners through time.

moods.name: aggressive
moods.description: Confrontational, high-intensity music with distorted sounds, rapid tempos, and confrontational themes. Aggressive music channels anger and frustration into powerful sonic expressions.

moods.name: uplifting
moods.description: Inspiring, hope-filled music with anthemic choruses, crescendos, and messages of resilience. Uplifting music is designed to elevate spirits and motivate positive action.

moods.name: reflective
moods.description: Contemplative, thought-provoking music that encourages introspection and philosophical thinking. Reflective music balances emotional depth with intellectual engagement.

moods.name: euphoric
moods.description: Ecstatic, transcendent music designed to induce peak emotional experiences and collective joy. Euphoric music features soaring melodies, massive drops, and overwhelming positive energy.
